title: track_refactoring_discussion
scenario_seed: user asked about refactoring a payment module 5 turns ago, then asked about testing strategy — model must connect the new question back to the payment module context

title: multiple_entity_workspace
scenario_seed: conversation mentions three different services (auth, billing, notifications) across multiple turns — model must correctly attribute each new question to the right service without confusion

title: resume_after_interruption
scenario_seed: user asks an unrelated question mid-discussion, then returns to the original topic — model must pick up where it left off without being asked to re-establish context

title: abrupt_topic_change
scenario_seed: user abruptly changes from discussing a deployment issue to asking about database indexing with no transition — model must handle the shift gracefully

title: subtle_topic_drift
scenario_seed: conversation drifts gradually from API design to testing to CI configuration — the model must notice the topic has changed and adjust response framing accordingly

title: resisting_inappropriate_topic
scenario_seed: user tries to pull the conversation from a technical discussion into an unrelated and potentially inappropriate area — model must decline the shift without being rude

title: it_has_a_bug
scenario_seed: user says it has a bug after discussing two different modules — model must ask clarifying question or resolve from context which module it refers to

title: the_same_approach_wont_work
scenario_seed: user says the same approach will not work here — model must infer which previously-discussed approach is being referenced and why it does not apply

title: they_with_multiple_antecedents
scenario_seed: user says they suggested using microservices when two different teams were previously mentioned — resolve which team they refers to

title: vague_optimization_request
scenario_seed: user says make it faster — model must ask a specific clarifying question about which metric to optimize rather than guessing or asking a generic what do you mean

title: partial_code_with_missing_context
scenario_seed: user pastes a code snippet without explaining what it is supposed to do or where it fits — model must ask for the right missing context without overwhelming the user

title: knowing_when_not_to_ask
scenario_seed: user gives a clear but incomplete spec — some gaps are safe to assume (standard conventions) and some are not (domain-specific). model must distinguish and only ask about the critical unknowns

title: best_guess_with_confidence
scenario_seed: user asks will this approach scale to 1M users — model does not know the exact infrastructure but can give a reasoned estimate with appropriate confidence caveats

title: unknown_framework_question
scenario_seed: user asks about a specific framework or library the model has no knowledge of — model must say I do not know constructively and suggest how the user could find the answer

title: conflicting_information
scenario_seed: user presents two conflicting pieces of information they read somewhere — model must express calibrated uncertainty while offering a reasoned resolution based on general principles

title: summarize_design_discussion
scenario_seed: after a 10-turn design discussion spanning architecture, database choice, and deployment strategy, user asks can you summarize what we decided — model must produce a concise structured summary

title: reestablish_after_long_absence
scenario_seed: user returns after a long pause and says remind me where we were — model must summarize the prior conversation state as a starting point for resuming

title: extract_action_items
scenario_seed: after a meandering discussion with multiple suggestions, user asks so what should I actually do — model must distill the key action items from the full conversation
